title: Changelog - October 2016
text:
## Changelog - October 2016
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000093657
New Features:
Bootstrap Image Settings. For further information click here .
New "Publish Date" Functionality For The Admin Blog. For more information click here .
Domain Manager Feature. More information in the following link .
Canonical Tags and Duplicate content functionality.
Member Feature sections are now available to work with Text Labels.
Image Update for Member Features. Click here for more information.
Facebook Feeds Widget. For further information, click here .
Enhancements / Fixes:
Full Optimization to the code Infrastructure with enhancements in all modules of the system.
More than 30+ bugs fixed ranging from Backend, Admin Panel, Frontend and more.
